title: Week rest programme
author: Ivan06
desc:
Half load workouts with greater volume to maintain your strength and improve your hypertrophy for the next cycle of a power building program. 

Alongside that there are 2 days with a 1RM tests for essential lifts. You can either do them at the start or end of a day. (Id recommend start)

ex.note: Add 2.5kg per set, onto your 1RM. If you fail a rep, that sets weight is your 1RM. if you completely fail a set, the previous set is your 1RM. If you fail all sets and reps, stick to original 1RM
